messages:
maya: digging deeper into microbundle indexing patterns after kevin's perf numbers. main goal: keep global index < 2MB for large models w/ many tiny tensors. ideas: hierarchical index + bloom filter + packed microbundles. anyone obj? 

simon: hierarchical index sounds good. top-level entries could be layer groups with offset to microbundle. then microbundle has inner index. reduces top-level count. 

anya: bloom filter for negative lookups is smart — avoids disk seeks when tensor not present. what false positive rate are we ok with? 1%? 0.1%? 

kevin: we saw disk seeks dominating when many misses. 1% FP is acceptable; coordinator will handle prefetch only on positives. we'll choose k=7 hash functions for 1% with small bloom. 

josh: packing CLI proposal: `model-bundle pack --safebox --microbundle-threshold=16 --bloom=0.01`. threshold = number of elements to collapse into microbundle. 

maya: +1. Also need fast index-only reader: read first N bytes (configurable) to get top-level index + bloom. if bloom says nope, skip. 

ci-bot: [ci] 1789010001 - safebox/index-tests triggered

anya: security: if microbundles have many tensors from different owners, we must keep provenance. store an origin pointer per microbundle with minimal size. provenance must be auditable. 

simon: provenance pointer could be an id -> lookup table in compat_manifest.json. avoid duplicating strings per entry. 

kevin: runtime: when index is loaded into memory, we should expose API: Index.Lookup(tensor_name) -> {bundle_offset, inner_offset, size, digest, hotness_hint}. keep it lock free read-only. 

maya: agree. make Index immutable once created (versioned). replace via atomic rename on disk. 

josh: tests: unit for bloomFP, integration that intentionally queries non-existent tensors to measure skipped seeks, fuzz pack/unpack. add perf regression alert in CI. 

ops-bot: [deploy] rolling artifact safebox-v0.1.0 uploaded to staging

anya: migration: for existing bundles, we can publish safebox alongside shards. WeightSource.Resolve should return preferred_order: [safebox, shards]. coordinator picks first available. 

simon: dedupe: chunks should include content-addressed id. for microbundles we can still dedupe at chunk level by splitting microbundle into fixed-size blocks or by internal chunking. tradeoff: more internal complexity vs dedupe gains. 

kevin: cheaper approach: only dedupe large tensors, rely on microbundle grouping to reduce metadata blowup. we can revisit dedupe-in-microbundle later. 

maya: instrumentation: record metrics: index_size_bytes, bloom_fp_rate_est, microbundle_count, avg_inner_index_size, avg_bundle_span_bytes, prefetch_misses, prefetch_hits. 

josh: add visualization tool `safebox-inspect` that prints layout and histograms. helpful during rollouts. 

anya: operations: expose per-safebox eviction hint `hotness_score` (0..1000) to warmup coordinator. this is an estimate from training/compile stage. 

simon: note on encryption: encrypted microbundles can't be mmap'd. mark them in index and ensure reader uses decrypt-then-cache path. add test for decrypt-edge-cases. 

kevin: actionables: i'll prototype bloom + index-only reader and push branch. target perf test next Tue (1789010800). 

maya: simon please draft tiny spec for index json schema and CLI flags. josh add CLI hooks. anya add migration doc. I'll consolidate into RFC note. 

ci-bot: [ci] 1789010200 - safebox/index-tests passed

maya: thanks all. if you're going to hack on this, please coordinate in this thread and push small PRs. :hammer_and_wrench: 

simon: SGTM. 

kevin: will ping when branch ready.
